concrete_scene.heading: Worked control period: miss the deadline, enter the safe state
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A learned controller, a plant-specific lease, a state estimator, a fallback controller, and an independent stop
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Admit one bounded move at tick 5 under observation-age, latency, actuator, state-envelope, and stopping-distance limits.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The modeled command is eligible while every predicate holds; worsened latency or stopping margin blocks it and transfers control to fallback.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether an unchanged symbolic action remains safe after timing or margin changes; it does not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Plant, estimator, controller, fallback, effect-observation, and physical-recovery owners retain all real-world truth and efficacy residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite lease trusts authored dynamics and safety fields and proves no deadline satisfaction, safe-set truth, braking effectiveness, or physical safety.

worked_trace.heading: Worked control period: miss the deadline, enter the safe state
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Finite admission and fallback routing are coherent for authored fields; real plant truth, schedulability, recovery, and safety remain unestablished.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The simpler controller executes the same command because the plan is unchanged. The lease path rechecks current timing and stopping margin and degrades when either fails.
readable_claim: A physically safe command is time-dependent: the same action can become inadmissible when its observation is stale, its deadline slips, or its stopping margin shrinks.
normative_rule: Recheck plant identity, observation age, latency, state envelope, actuator limit, and stopping distance every control period. A deadline miss or lost margin immediately narrows the lease to the independent hold or stop path; the learned controller cannot vote itself more time.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene consolidates the authored-plant limitation after the concrete fallback trace.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Timing, dynamics, estimation, safe sets, fallback, human safety, recovery, effects, deployment, and transfer remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: Tick, interval, latency, actuator, and margin numbers remain reader-facing; exhaustive lifecycle fields remain in formal evidence surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The reader claim and rule project the lease into a timing decision.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: One boundary preserves the difference between lease logic and physical safety.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Safety-envelope tables remain where numeric control obligations require comparison.

non_claims: The finite lease is not a physical control experiment.
Authored fallback readiness does not establish fallback effectiveness.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
